title: ID0426378-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002797]Charger issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The station stopped connecting to the SCB, it was unavailable for some time. After a few hours, when she appeared in the SCB, she reported "FailsSaveMode". After the restart, it did not turn on. After an on-site visit and manual restart, the power-up process is completed at 30%. Please help or escalate to L3 as soon as possible, this charger is in very crowded location. The .10, .11, .14 components can be seen on the web. Could there be a problem in software/ linux? Cfast card?
Solution:
